svg.text: Reunite · Lost & Found India — Architecture & Data Flow
Next.js on Vercel · Neon Postgres + pgvector · Vercel Blob · Groq vision · Cloudflare Workers AI embeddings
Serverless functions in sin1 (Singapore) · all AI & DB calls are server-only
No login: the link is the key
Local dev: npx vercel env pull .env.local
Public photo store (items/*.jpg) · serves images to the browser
① Browser submits the form (photo already shrunk) to the createReport server action
② Photo is stored in Vercel Blob; its public URL comes back
③ Groq vision describes the photo in one line (key rotation on rate limits)
④ Cloudflare turns title + category + description + caption + place into a vector
⑤ Row and vector are saved in Neon ⑥ User is redirected to their report page
Showing matches (fresh on every page view)
⑦ Page asks matching.ts for matches of the opposite type (lost ↔ found)
⑧ pgvector finds the 20 nearest reports within ±30 days; rows come back
⑨ Scored on meaning 60% · place 20% · time 20%; top 5 at ≥40%, plus nearby reports
⑩ Page streams match cards with photos, reasons and contact details to the browser
New reports from others appear automatically the next time the page is opened
